DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

Given the MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, this is consistent with PML, an opportunistic infection of the central nervous system typically caused by reactivation of the JC virus, often in immunocompromised patients. Do you have a history of HIV/AIDS, or are you currently taking medications like rituximab or natalizumab?
